title: Family-Approved Old Bay Salmon Patties Recipe
description: In this family-approved Old Bay salmon patties recipe, canned salmon is seasoned with a zesty Old Bay seasoning mix, formed into patties, and pan-fried.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) package savory herb-seasoned stuffing mix (such as Stove Top®), crushed
2 tablespoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
2 (14 ounce) cans salmon, drained and flaked

steps.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion; cook until lightly softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Transfer onion to a bowl; reserve drippings in the skillet.

Stir stuffing mix, butter, eggs, seafood seasoning, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, dry mustard, and coriander into onion until well mixed. Stir in salmon until well combined; divide and form into 8 patties (I use an old egg ring that works great).
Heat the same skillet over medium heat. Add patties; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes per side.
